prompt: Xcode has separate safeguards for repeated tool calls and for consecutive unproductive steps. When an identical write operation repeatedly fails, the run currently stops with a repeated-tool-call diagnosis before the persistent tool failure can be handled by the idle/error path. Fix the watchdog coordination so all-error repetitions preserve the underlying failure signal, while successful or partly successful repeated calls are still bounded. Run focused tests and avoid unrelated changes.
known_limitations: The deterministic oracle exercises watchdog state transitions directly; it does not make paid provider calls or require an actual disk-full host.
